source_title: 10 overground workers arrested in terror financing case in J&K's Shopian
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Jammu and Kashmir Police arrested 10 overground workers (OGWs) in connection with a terror financing module in Shopian district, officials told PTI on Friday.The arrests were made during an investigation into suspected terror financing activities in the south Kashmir district. Police said the accused were allegedly involved in supporting terrorist networks through financial and logistical assistance.More details awaited.Get the latest India News and Live updates.
